name: baseline
note: All three roles on deepseek/deepseek-chat. Kept as the control -- newer variants below are measured against this one.

name: baseline-norag
note: Retrieval-toggle A/B against baseline: same three deepseek-chat roles, but use_retrieval=false so the 對話 agent never gets wuxia_corpus_search at all -- no Chroma index or embedding model needed. Retrieval is the largest token cost per CLAUDE.md's model-split numbers, so this quantifies both the cost saved and the 武俠語感 lost (or not) from a model's native register alone. Hidden from the UI's variant picker (ui_visible=false) -- still fully runnable via --variants baseline-norag.

name: deepseek-v4-pro
note: 2026-08-19 no-RAG A/B at script_length=long (the production-scale target -- prior 2026-08-17 feasibility runs used script_length=medium and have been retired, see git history). Mechanical roles (extractor/beat_expander) on the cheaper deepseek-v4-flash-0731; writer/dialogue-scene_writer/proof on deepseek-v4-pro-0423 for prose quality at full script length. Paired with deepseek-v4-pro-norag below to measure what wuxia_corpus_search retrieval actually buys at this model tier.

name: deepseek-v4-pro-norag
note: Retrieval-toggle A/B against deepseek-v4-pro (same six-role model split, script_length=long) -- use_retrieval=false so the dialogue/scene_writer agent never gets wuxia_corpus_search. Hidden from the UI's variant picker (ui_visible=false) -- still fully runnable via --variants deepseek-v4-pro-norag.

name: flash-only
note: 六個 role 全部 deepseek-v4-flash-0731——重現目前正式環境的唯一模型設定，作為 2026-08-21 通過率修復工作（wire.py 寬鬆鏡像／normalize.py 機械式修復／SessionDocument.allowed_ids 封閉選單）的唯一測試組，前後基準比較都用這組。script_length=long 與 deepseek-v4-pro 對齊以便直接比較。2026-08-22：移除了 flash-glm-prose 變體（z-ai/glm-5.2 不支援結構化 JSON schema 輸出，會把 JSON 包在 ```json markdown code fence 裡卡死 crewai 的 output_pydantic 解析器，經確認不可行）——flash-only 是目前唯一通過測試、也是正式環境實際配置的變體，Phase 4 schema 瘦身的線上 A/B 基準只用這組。
